title: test(ui): promote the Studio live specs into Live E2E UI, with a stored-state re-read each
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_
Fixes #27554

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 的两组浏览器实时用例（对象设计器 F1–F4、页面编辑器）从「只在夜间跑」移进必过检查 `Live E2E UI` 的清单；两组各加一条「保存后经 `/meta` 回读存储内容」的断言。
- **为什么改**：Studio 保存路径近期多次在合并后才被发现坏掉（#27459、#27461、#26917），而这两组用例只在夜间跑、红了不拦合并；加回读断言后，测的是真正存下来的东西，而不只是界面状态。
- **风险与回滚**：只动测试和 `ui/package.json` 的两条脚本清单，不改产品代码。代价是 `Run the live e2e specs` 步骤本地从约 18 秒变成约 36 秒，仍远低于 #27550 定的 2 分钟预算。回滚 = 把两个文件名移回 `test:e2e:live:nightly`。
- **先看**：`ui/e2e/live/studio-object-designer.spec.ts` 的 F4（新建可写包、保存、回读草稿）；`ui/e2e/live/studio-editor.spec.ts` 的 Add block 用例尾部；`ui/package.json` 两条脚本。
- **两分钟验证**：看本 PR 的 `Live E2E UI` 检查日志，`Run the live e2e specs` 步骤应列出 11 条全部通过，其中 6 条来自两个 studio 文件，步骤耗时在 2 分钟内。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/package.json`: `studio-object-designer.spec.ts` and `studio-editor.spec.ts` move from `test:e2e:live:nightly` to `test:e2e:live:ci`, the allowlist the required `Live E2E UI` job runs. Both passed the promotion rule (readings below), so neither stays in nightly and no header carries a "kept in nightly" reason.
- `studio-object-designer.spec.ts` F4 now saves and reads back. The showcase package is provided by code, so a save into it is refused (`WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`, measured: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase` answers 422). F4 therefore authors its own package through `POST /api/v1/packages`, opens the designer on it, runs the same picklist + empty-row steps and the same two negative banner assertions as before, clicks Save, asserts the `PUT ...?mode=draft` answered 2xx, and reads `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME?state=draft`: the stored object has exactly one `select` field and its `options` equal `[{ value: 'open', label: 'Open' }]`, so the empty row was not stored. The package is deleted in `finally`, as F1 already does for its own.
- `studio-editor.spec.ts` "Add block opens a block-type picker…" now picks Card after asserting the picker, waits for the editor's autosave `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/NAME?mode=draft` (asserted 2xx), and reads `GET /api/v1/meta/page/NAME?state=draft`: the first region holds one more block than the shipped copy, and the new last block is `page:card`.
- Both headers say they are in the `:ci` allowlist since this card, under the rule, the way `saved-view-filter.spec.ts` says it.

## Why

The card's task 1–4: measure, promote what passes the 3/3 + 5/5 rule, add one stored-state re-read per spec, stay inside #27550's 2-minute budget for the `Run the live e2e specs` step. Both specs fit, so the higher-yield-only fallback (F4 / F1) did not apply.

## Verification

All runs: this branch's workspace backend (`ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on `examples/app-showcase`, port 4010) and the Console production build (`VITE_BASE_PATH=/ vite build`) served by `vite preview` on 5190 with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, the `Live E2E UI` job's stack step for step; `--retries 0`; one long-lived backend across all runs (the CI job boots a fresh one per run, so this is the harder condition). Container: 4 shared cores.

| Reading | Runs | Result | Playwright total per run |
|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline, both specs unchanged (task 1) | 10 | 10/10 green, 60/60 tests | 16.4–17.9 s |
| Both specs as changed here | 10 | 10/10 green, 60/60 tests (incl. 3/3 consecutive) | 19.1–20.0 s |
| Enlarged allowlist, `pnpm run test:e2e:live:ci` (task 2's 5/5) | 5 | 5/5 green, 55/55 tests | 33.9–37.2 s (wall 35.3–38.7 s) |
| Incumbent four specs alone (control) | 3 | 3/3 green | 16.7–17.8 s (wall 18.0–19.3 s) |

<details><summary>Per-test time, 10 runs each (mean / max)</summary>

| Test | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| designer F1 (package switcher) | 2.4 / 2.5 s | 2.4 / 2.5 s |
| designer F2 (typed underscore) | 2.1 / 2.2 s | 2.2 / 2.3 s |
| designer F3 (label to API name) | 2.3 / 3.3 s | 2.4 / 2.6 s |
| designer F4 (picklist empty row; now saves + re-reads) | 3.6 / 4.0 s | 4.0 / 4.4 s |
| editor, page editor loads | 2.8 / 3.0 s | 2.8 / 3.0 s |
| editor, Add block picker (now adds Card + re-reads draft) | 2.8 / 3.1 s | 4.6 / 5.0 s |

</details>

Budget: the two specs add about 18–20 s to the step locally (incumbent four 18–19 s wall, enlarged six 35–39 s). The job comment in `ci.yml` measured the incumbent step at 14–24 s (median 21 s) on CI, so the projected step is about 40 s, against the 120 s budget. This PR's own `Live E2E UI` run is the first CI reading.

Nightly readings: the nightly live tier that runs `test:e2e:live:nightly` (`examples/app-showcase/test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts`) has at most two scheduled runs since it was wired (2026-10-28 and 2026-10-29), and both of those `Nightly tiers` runs failed on other shards' packages; their per-spec logs were not readable from this container (the job-log download is refused by the proxy). The ≥ 10 readings are therefore the local ones above, which the card allows.

No ablation: the diff changes tests and a script list only, no product behaviour.

Gates at head `75f8060c`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 31 families from the three changed paths; each ran locally, plus `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: 32 lines, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 31 derived, 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. CI runs the rest (the repo-wide scans, `Live E2E UI` itself).

## Acceptance notes

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `live-e2e-ui` comment still says "What it runs: the four allowlisted live specs"; it is now six. `ci.yml` is out of bounds for this card, so the wording is left for whoever next edits that job; the count is not read by any gate.
- `examples/app-showcase/test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts` says "Four of its specs are the required `Live E2E UI` job". Same stale count, outside this card's file surface; the test reads the nightly script by name, so its behaviour is unchanged (13 specs instead of 15).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` says F4 "never publishes or reads the stored options". F4 now saves a draft and reads its stored options (it still does not publish), so that note is narrower than the spec now is; the ledger is its owner's to re-read, outside this card.
- Siblings #27551 and #27552 edit the same two script lines; whichever lands second takes a one-line merge.
